findings.finding: Set BC=Fₙ₊₂, BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ b=c+Fₙ₋₁. Incircle radius r=√(FₙFₙ₊₁(s−Fₙ₊₂)/s). Using coordinates (I at (0,0), D(0,−r), B(−Fₙ,−r), C(Fₙ₊₁,−r)), compute F,E, A, K (second intersection of (AFE) & Ω). Condition “K,N,K′,B cyclic” ⇔ circumcenter of ΔBNK lies on EF ⇒ unique r solving f(r)=0. For each n the ratio CT·NB/(BT·NE) simplifies to Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁, so aₙ=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁. Hence a_{2n}=F_{2n+2}/F_{2n-1}→φ³=2+√5. α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5 ⇒ floor(2^{5²})=2^{25}=33 554 432. 33 554 432 mod 99991 = **57447**.
